intent: Let a user build a CSS gradient by positioning color stops and an angle.
avoid_when: a single flat color is all that's needed (use color-picker)
a11y_contract: the angle handle and each color stop are custom `role="slider"` elements (React Aria has no built-in 2D-angle primitive) with aria-valuemin/max/now, and the angle additionally sets aria-valuetext in degrees; every stop and handle gets a positional aria-label (e.g. "Stop 2 position") generated automatically from its index
requires_data: a controlled list of color stops and an angle value
